description: Update Sender - Update email sender settings (warmup, inbox, signature, tracking domain, etc.)

auto_ramp_up_enabled.description: Enable auto ramp-up: start at starting_warmup_frequency and add ramp_up_frequency each day up to max_daily_frequency

folder.description: Email-sender folder ID to move the sender into. Must be a folder created with type 'email-sender'. An empty string removes the sender from its current folder.

max_daily_frequency.description: Daily warmup limit (1-50). With auto ramp-up off this is the daily limit; with it on, the ceiling.

pause_cold_emails_when_health_low.description: Pause cold emails when health is low

ramp_up_frequency.description: Daily increment when auto ramp-up is on (1-50)

starting_warmup_frequency.description: Initial daily limit when auto ramp-up is on (1-50)

warmup_keyword.description: Warmup filter tag: two words joined by a dash, e.g. 'blue-river'. It is included in every warmup email so the user can filter them.

enabled.description: true: send warmup emails only in the slots below. false: send throughout the day.

timezone.description: IANA timezone the slot times are in, e.g. 'America/New_York'. Omitted: keeps the stored timezone (UTC if none).

warmup_schedule.description: Days and time slots when warmup emails and replies may be sent. null switches the schedule off and keeps its days.

warmup_templates.description: IDs of this workspace's email templates to warm up. An empty array removes all. Requires a plan with warmup templates.

warmup_urls.description: Warmup link IDs (the id values from get_warmup_links) to insert into warmup emails. An empty array removes all links. Requires a plan with warmup links.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID this action applies to. When omitted, the current or default workspace is used.

name: update_sender

result.description: The raw result returned by the SalesBlink tool.
